target.value_rule: strictly positive finite author-reported value; blanks, explicit zero and NA are excluded without imputation
target.rank_rule: descending midrank percentile computed independently within each source measurement batch using all eligible source rows
target.identity_feature_policy: protein identity, source identity, laboratory identity, sample labels, author abundance and author rank are prohibited predictive features

target_freeze.selection_rule: strict positive finite canonical-accession intersection of the three pre-audited source maps, computed before model execution

nested_selection.method: leave-one-measurement-batch-out within the non-held-out laboratory cohorts

uncertainty.method: within-unit mean across qualified batches followed by biological-unit cluster bootstrap

negative_control.method: within-development-measurement-batch target permutation with nested-selected alpha held fixed

claim_boundary: This is a pre-registered author-run analysis-only three-laboratory biological-cohort common-target execution. It establishes an exact five-target intersection across three paper-attached source maps with explicit biological-unit identifiers and source-held-out model results. It is not an independent evaluator receipt, no-author reproduction, protected lockbox, clinical validation, community adoption or scientific submission readiness evidence. The non-redistributable/unclear-license source assets and numeric derivatives remain analysis-only.
